case_title: Sat Parkash v. State of Haryana and Another
trial_court_outcome: Acquitted of murder, convicted under s.363, s.366, s.366-A, s.368, s.376
neutral_facts: The accused, along with his uncle and aunt, were charged with kidnapping, rape, and murder of a minor girl. The prosecution alleged that the accused kidnapped the girl and raped her, while the uncle and aunt concealed her in their house. The girl was found dead in the accused's residence. The accused and the girl were found to have attempted suicide together, with the girl dying. The accused's attempt to commit suicide was noted. The girl's suicide note stated that she left her home by her own free will and committed suicide, which led to the acquittal of the accused on charges of kidnapping, rape, and murder. The prosecution's case relied on the presumption that the accused had kidnapped the girl based on her being found in his residence, but this presumption was deemed misconceived.
